Order No.06 Dated- 20.07.2023
Heard learned counsel for the parties.

Apprehending his arrest in connection with Basantrai P.S. Case No. 77 of 2022 corresponding to G.R. No. 1543 of 2022 instituted under Sections 341/323/498A/354/420/504 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3/ 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, the petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.
As per FIR, the allegation is that the present petitioner has solemnized marriage with the informant concealing the fact that he is already father of five children and his wife has been died.
There is also allegation of demand of additional dowry of Rs. 1,00,000/- cash.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence at all rather he has been falsely implicated in this case.

It is submitted that before the marriage, the petitioner has already stated to the informant who resides in the neighbouring village and her elder sister regarding earlier marriage and his children, but the informant has falsely stated that she has no knowledge about the earlier marriage of the petitioner.

It is further submitted that petitioner undertakes to co-operate with the investigation of the case and will not indulge in tampering with prosecution evidence and will abide by all terms and conditions imposed by this Court in the matter of granting anticipatory bail.
Hence, it is submitted that the petitioner may be extended the privilege of anticipatory bail.
Learned Addl.P.P appearing for the State as well as learned counsel appearing for the opposite party no. 2 have opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner.

sentences.text: Considering the facts and circumstances of this case, the nature of allegation against petitioner coupled with materials available on record, I am inclined to extend privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, the petitioner is directed to surrender in the Court within four weeks from today and in the event of his arrest or surrendering, he will be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/- (Twenty thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned J.M. 1st Class, Godda in connection with Basantrai P.S. Case No. 77 of 2022 corresponding to G.R. No. 1543 of 2022 with the condition that he will co-operate with the investigation of the case and appear before the investigating officer as and when noticed by him and furnish his mobile number and photocopy of the Aadhar Card with an undertaking that he will not change his mobile number during the pendency of the case and subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

(Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) Umesh/-
